# Laisky One API Developer Notes For Agents

- [Developer overview](https://oneapi.laisky.com/developers)
- [Agent mode](https://oneapi.laisky.com/?mode=agent)
- [Agent card](https://oneapi.laisky.com/.well-known/agent-card.json)

Use these files to discover capabilities before attempting authenticated relay calls.
